population: Same cached Train256/Dev128/Seen128 primary max cutoff families; fixed784 cells/20m; full cached public objects graph. No Backbone/GAT/RGB/controller training.
methods: A3 scoped factors, single syntactic scope
A4 scoped factors plus parse/coreference hypotheses
design: Develop only Train and Dev. Compare span grammar and frozen en_core_web_sm dependency-assisted parsing. Target is a nominal entity, not truncated instruction; names outside target nominal span cannot bind target. Role/scope uncertainty kept as hypotheses. No private labels normal forward.
selection: Dev choose parser backend using weak role score then Goal R1, ties rule backend. Mixture weights fixed candidate {0,.25,.5}; R1 then lowerdamage then smallerweight. No Seen tuning.
scope: Between joint>=2 entities; nested reference-reference relation updates anchor belief rather than treating every edge as target relation. Relative frames remain multiple hypotheses.
no_evidence: unknown target or no supported factor => unchanged A0 heatmap. Unknown factor contributes no penalty.
annotation: Offline processed_descriptions only weak target/landmark supervision, accessed using sealed sample label key. Separate raw-text-only analyst audit created before parser predictions; not independently human verified. Ambiguous annotations count Unknown and are not forced correct. Synthetic controlled sentences separate.
stage1_gate: role>=90%, scope>=85% on independently verifiable audit; report full denominator/unknown. No external human annotation verification means certification is limited, never silently call weak labels manual truth.
goal_gate: vs frozen P5 A2 >=1pp, map95CI lower>0; Recovery>Damage, Net>0; no systematic Train/Dev regression
seen: one final fixed confirmation after Dev freeze; disclose prior exploratory Seen exposure. No Unseen/closedloop if either gate fails.
